q: Do truck chassis and frame parts exported to the EU need CBAM data?
title: Truck frame parts: CBAM check
short: Usually not, if they are declared as parts of motor vehicles under heading 8708, which is outside CBAM. Check each line: fasteners under 7318, structures under 7308 and other steel articles under 7326 are covered, so a mixed shipment may still need embedded emissions for some lines.
audience: Chassis, frame, bracket and axle part makers in Jamshedpur, Pune, Pithampur and Hosur exporting to EU truck makers

ol: Get the CN code your importer uses for each line.
Compare with Annex I of the CBAM Regulation.
Prepare embedded emissions only for covered lines.

p: Truck makers ask for product footprints for their own Scope 3 and targets even when CBAM does not apply. Keep a per part figure ready.
Store the classification the importer used. If customs reclassifies a part into a covered heading, you will need data quickly.

senseible: Senseible reads your invoices into dated, fingerprinted records and its CBAM check flags which goods fall under the regulation. Senseible does not classify goods for customs or file CBAM declarations.
